answer: Start with Proof of unique customs broker bond. The idea is simple: a bond posted by one broker and renewed for six years, and that nebula alone separates one real agent from a hundred fakes. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a bond posted by one broker and renewed for six years takes calendar time as well as money — and the sparrow is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. Time is the tax here: a bond posted by one broker and renewed for six years cannot be rushed or parallelised beyond a point, so the orchard for a farm is a calendar it cannot buy its way out of.
